## Purpose and ownership

SCGSim provides two views of the same solver-bound semantic scene. An inline
Notebook viewer supports interactive rotation, pan, zoom, and camera reset.
Deterministic headless contact sheets remain the portable, hash-bound review
artifact. Neither surface redefines PDK or component semantics, solver
geometry, run status, or scientific evidence.

Palace previews read a Palace `.msh` file through `meshio` and render with
PyVista off-screen. Their authority is the mesh tags together with the mesh
manifest and the config/index mapping. AEDT previews use PyAEDT 1.3.0 in
non-graphical mode: assignments and identity come from native readback, and
each native object is exported as OBJ before off-screen rendering. Inspecting a
raw `.aedt` project requires the caller to select the design explicitly.

## Public surface

| Surface | Contract |
|---|---|
| `inspect_palace_geometry(run_dir)` | Bind a Palace run directory and its authoritative mesh metadata. |
| `inspect_aedt_geometry(source, ...)` | Bind an AEDT source; a raw `.aedt` source requires an explicit design. |
| `preview.show_materials()` | Render the available material assignments. |
| `preview.show_boundaries()` | Render the available boundary assignments. |
| `preview.show_surface_epr()` | Render the available Surface-EPR assignments. |
| `preview.show_mesh()` | Render the available mesh. |
| `preview.show_all_previews()` | Invoke Materials, Boundaries, Surface EPR, then Mesh exactly once each, and return `None`. |
| `preview.explore(mode)` | Display one self-contained, client-side VTK.js scene for `materials`, `boundaries`, `surface_epr`, or `mesh`. |

Unavailable modes are reported explicitly. SCGSim must not infer a missing
assignment or emit a blank image that looks successful. AEDT Surface-EPR and
mesh previews may therefore be unavailable even when another AEDT preview mode
is valid.

## Inline Notebook viewer

`preview.explore(mode)` displays the semantic table above one PyVista scene.
PyVista's `jupyter_backend="html"` serializes the scene geometry into the live
Notebook output, where VTK.js supplies rotation, pan, zoom, axes, and camera
reset controls. Because no localhost Trame server or `/proxy/<port>/` iframe is
involved, the viewer works in a VS Code Remote SSH Notebook without sudo, GPU
device permission, port forwarding, or Jupyter Server Proxy.

The inline widget verifies the same bound source hashes as the deterministic
renderer, but creates no `.html` sidecar file and changes no receipt, archive,
handoff identity, or simulation status. It is a live Notebook display, not a
saved or exported portable HTML artifact. A connected Notebook kernel and the
`scgsim[visualization]` extra are required.

## Curated views and contact sheet

Every available mode writes 12 fixed light-theme views under
`previews/geometry/<mode>/`:

- the six axis views `+X`, `-X`, `+Y`, `-Y`, `+Z`, and `-Z`;
- four diagonal views; and
- X-center and Y-center visualization clips.

The default tile size is 1600 × 1200 pixels. A contact sheet, approximately
4800 × 4200 pixels, places a legend table above a 4 × 3 view grid. The legend
shows each exact semantic ID, display label, semantic role, and object or entity
count. Distinct semantic IDs are never merged merely because their labels or
colors match.

The fixed semantic colors are:

| Semantic role | Color |
|---|---|
| Ground or PEC | Charcoal |
| Lumped Port | Magenta |
| MA | Orange |
| MS | Green |
| SA | Blue |
| MS_MA | Purple |
| Unassigned | Light gray |

Other exact semantic IDs receive deterministic colors from a colorblind-safe
palette. Mapping must come from authoritative solver metadata. Unknown or
ambiguous mapping fails closed; names, bounding boxes, existing colors, and
rendered appearance are never semantic inference sources.

## Manifest and evidence boundary

`metadata/geometry_preview_manifest.json` records the preview status, selected
AEDT design where applicable, tool versions, palette, ordered views, and
produced artifacts. It hashes the bound source, the solver-authoritative part
of an AEDT receipt, and every produced artifact. An AEDT run receipt adds a
`geometry_preview` binding for the manifest and artifact hashes; this binding
does not change simulation status or the receipt authority hash. Raw `.aedt`
inspection never edits an adjacent run receipt.

Palace previews produced before `prepare_handoff()` are included automatically
in the existing handoff archive and its member hashes. A later diagnostic
preview remains a truthful sidecar, unsealed until a later archive operation
includes and hashes it.

Preview artifacts are excluded from solver and handoff identity. Rendering
failure is recorded as preview failure or unavailability and never changes a
simulation's execution, completion, or scientific status.

## V1 exclusions

V1 does not include ParaView, Gmsh with Xvfb, portable interactive HTML, actor
filters, custom camera definitions, interactive clipping, or a dark rendering
theme. Portable HTML remains a separate Human decision after review of the
inline viewer.
